title: 她的痛你要加倍承受
slug: 豪门情变前夫过期不候全本免费-豪门情变前夫过期不候最新章节列表
content_zh:
单手启开烟盒叼了根烟，手中的打火机“砰砰卡卡”半晌都没点着。
“叩叩”敲门声让浮动的心更加烦躁。
“进来！”
祁荣推门而入，看得出他心情很差，“二少！”
顾少卿背对着他，“你马上动身去巴黎，你唯一的任务就是护尹小姐周全！”
“是！”
“大少的行踪查到了吗？”
“他住在酒店，看上去好像没有回顾家的打算！”
他手指稍用力捏碎了指尖的烟，狭长的眸危险地眯起，‘顾天承怎么会查到那里？他发现了多少？他想干什么？’
“你去吧！”
“是！”祁荣退出来，心有疑惑，他一直都不知道，那位尹小姐到底何许神圣，能让二少这样上心。
这是哪里？周围漆黑一片，寂静得让心语恐惧。一丝光亮刺痛眼眸，她看到顾少卿站在彼岸，欣喜朝他飞奔而去，抱紧他，“少卿，我爱你，不要离开我！”
“可是我从来没有爱过你，你知道你有多令我厌恶吗？”他的声音像是从地狱传来的。
心语全身僵硬，惊恐地看着他，他温柔地笑着，推开她。他背后出现一个女人，看不清脸，他温柔地拥着她，眼底满满的柔情。他们两一步一步逼近她，她颤抖着后退，身后突然变成万丈深渊，猝不及防，两只手凶狠地推她堕入万丈深渊……
“少卿……”心语闭着眼挣扎，出了一身冷汗，手指无意识的抓紧床单。
顾少卿踱到她床前，“颜心语，你爱我是吗？你越爱我，到最后就会伤得越深！倩雪所承受的痛苦，你要加倍承受，失去孩子的锥心之痛，我也要让你尝尝！
“豪门婚变：风流二少挂彩，正室医院捉奸！”第二天，各大报纸杂志竞相报道，整版大幅都印着颜心语的照片。
一大清早，意识还是恍惚的心语接到婆婆的电话，雷庭之怒，婆婆说了什么，她全然没听清，只听到最后一句，‘你们两马上回来见我！’
挂断电话，心语只是痴痴地坐着，房间好静，静得人心里害怕，那个梦一点点的从潜意识里浮现出来，逼真得能让她回忆起所有细节。
她甩了甩头，想脱离那种不能自拔的情绪，拔通他的电话，电话响了好一会儿才被接起，那边声音有些嘈杂，好似有女子娇媚地申吟，“恩——少卿——”

心语感觉喉咙里跟被人硬塞了一把干稻草似的，又疼又难受，捏电话的手收紧。
“妈妈让我们回一趟顾园。”她尽量让自己的声音听起来平静。
“知道了！”
“少卿，啊——”女人高亢的吟叫在电话挂断前清晰地传到她耳朵里。
她将电话狠狠的扔了出去，像是丢掉让她恶心的脏东西，很不争气的，泪在下一秒落下来……

content_en:
He opened the cigarette case with one hand and took a cigarette in his mouth. The lighter in his hand went "bang bang" and didn't light up for a long time.
"Knock knock" knock on the door made my floating heart even more irritable.
"Come in!"
Qi Rong pushed the door open and saw that he was in a bad mood, "Second Young Master!"
Gu Shaoqing turned her back to him, "You are leaving for Paris immediately. Your only mission is to protect Miss Yin!"
"Yes!"
"Have you found out the whereabouts of the young master?"
"He's staying in a hotel and doesn't look like he has any plans to return home!"
He crushed the cigarette on his fingertips with a little force, and his narrow eyes narrowed dangerously, 'How could Gu Tiancheng find out there? How many did he find? What does he want to do? ’
"You go ahead!"
"Yes!" Qi Rong withdrew, confused. He never knew how sacred Miss Yin was to make the Second Young Master so interested.
Where is this? The surroundings were pitch black, and the silence was so terrifying that Xinyu was frightened. A ray of light hurt her eyes, and she saw Gu Shaoqing standing on the other side. She ran towards him happily and hugged him tightly, "Shaoqing, I love you, don't leave me!"
"But I have never loved you. Do you know how much you disgust me?" His voice sounded like it was coming from hell.
Xinyu stiffened and looked at him in horror. He smiled softly and pushed her away. A woman appeared behind him, whose face he could not see clearly. He hugged her tenderly, his eyes full of tenderness. They approached her one step at a time. She backed away tremblingly, and suddenly an abyss turned into an abyss behind her. She was caught off guard, and two hands pushed her fiercely into the abyss...
"Shaoqing..." Xinyu struggled with her eyes closed, breaking out in a cold sweat, and her fingers unconsciously grasped the sheets.
Gu Shaoqing walked to her bed and said, "Yan Xinyu, you love me, don't you? The more you love me, the deeper you will be hurt in the end! You have to bear the pain Qianxue has endured twice as much. I also want you to taste the heartbreaking pain of losing a child!"
"Marriage changes in a rich family: the romantic second young master is in trouble, and the main wife is caught in the hospital!" "The next day, major newspapers and magazines reported on it, and Yan Xinyu's photo was printed on the entire page.
Early in the morning, Xinyu, who was still in a trance, received a call from her mother-in-law. She didn't hear what her mother-in-law said clearly. She only heard the last sentence, 'You two will come back to see me right away! ’
After hanging up the phone, Xinyu just sat there dreamingly. The room was so quiet, so quiet that it made people feel scared. The dream emerged from her subconscious little by little, so realistic that she could recall all the details.
She shook her head, trying to get rid of the overwhelming emotion, and dialed his phone. The phone rang for a while before she was picked up. The voice on the other end was a little noisy, as if a woman was coquettishly moaning, "Well - Shaoqing -"
Xinyu felt as if someone had stuffed a handful of dry straw into her throat. It was painful and uncomfortable, and she tightened her grip on the phone.
"Mom asked us to go back to Gu Garden. ” She tried to sound calm.
"Got it! "
"Shaoqing, ah——" The woman's high-pitched moan reached her ears clearly before the phone was hung up.
She threw the phone away fiercely, as if she was throwing away something dirty that made her sick. She was disappointed, and tears fell down in the next second...
